title: Integrated gradient bound for the composed cut-off χ∘g (Simon (4c) for one smooth approximant)
statement: For all P, m ∈ ℕ, every measure μ on ℝ^P, every m-form ω : ℝ^P → Covector(ℝ^P, m) (an arbitrary DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m; no smoothness or support assumption) with covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for every x, all functions f, g : ℝ^P → ℝ with g differentiable on ℝ^P, every LW ∈ ℝ≥0, every differentiable χ : ℝ → ℝ and all reals t, h, c, δ such that, with K := tsupport ω (the closure of {x | ω(x) ≠ 0}), |g(x) − f(x)| ≤ δ and ‖Dg(x)‖₊ ≤ LW in ℝ≥0 for every x ∈ K (Dg(x) = fderiv ℝ g x; ‖·‖₊ is the operator norm as an element of ℝ≥0), |χ′(s)| ≤ c for every s (χ′ = deriv χ), and χ′(s) = 0 for every s ∉ (t − h, t): in [0, ∞], ∫⁻ ‖Dψ(x)‖₊ · ofReal(covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x))) dμ(x) ≤ ofReal(c) · LW · μ(K ∩ f⁻¹((t − h − δ, t + δ))), where ψ := (y ↦ χ(g(y))) and Dψ(x) = fderiv ℝ ψ x (operator norm, ‖·‖₊ its ℝ≥0 version coerced to ℝ≥0∞).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) (f g : Eucl P → ℝ) (LW : ℝ≥0) (χ : ℝ → ℝ) (t h c δ : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) → Differentiable ℝ g → Differentiable ℝ χ → (∀ x ∈ tsupport ω, |g x - f x| ≤ δ) → (∀ x ∈ tsupport ω, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖₊ ≤ LW) → (∀ s, |deriv χ s| ≤ c) → (∀ s, s ∉ Ioo (t - h) t → deriv χ s = 0) → ∫⁻ x, (‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => χ (g y)) x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (tsupport ω ∩ f ⁻¹' Ioo (t - h - δ) (t + δ))
